operating_entities.note: Page text: 'The organizational chart shows the current corporate relationships between Great-West Lifeco and certain of its subsidiaries. Power Corporation of Canada indirectly controls approximately 70% of the outstanding common shares of Great-West Lifeco, representing approximately 65% of the voting rights...'. The page is on the parent's (Great-West Lifeco, a pure insurance holding company) own site because canadalife.com has no operating-entities page: checked canadalife.com/about-us.html, /about-us/who-we-are.html (says only 'Canada Life is a subsidiary of Great-West Lifeco Inc. and is a member of the Power Corporation group'), /about-us/amalgamation.html (Great-West Life, London Life, Canada Life and holdcos Canada Life Financial Corporation and London Insurance Group Inc. amalgamated 2020-01-01 into The Canada Life Assurance Company), /about-us/governance.html; /legal.html redirects to terms-of-use. Power Corporation / IGM / Mackenzie / Sagard / Northleaf / Franklin Templeton are NOT on this page and are excluded per rule 1. GA manager: no sentence on the page; GWL Realty Advisors Inc. (real estate) and PanAgora (quant) are the only asset-management boxes.

cio.name: John Melvin
cio.title: Executive Vice-President and Chief Investment Officer, Great-West Lifeco Inc. and Canada Life
cio.entity: Great-West Lifeco Inc. (group 'Global Investments' function; also an officer of The Canada Life Assurance Company)
cio.reports_to: President & CEO David Harney (inferred: CEO announced the hire and he is listed among Lifeco senior officers; release does not state the line)
cio.prior: Sammons Financial Group SVP & CIO (Jul/Aug 2021-Sep 2025); Hartford Investment Management Co. CIO / MD & Head of Portfolio Management (c.2015-21); Goldman Sachs Asset Management MD & CIO Insurance Asset Management (c.2011-15); Deutsche Bank MD, Head of Insurance Fixed Income Americas; MBA NYU Stern, BA Lehigh
cio.tenure_source: press release 4 Sep 2025 + Lifeco leadership bio ('appointed CIO on Oct. 1, 2025'); prior-role dates from theorg.com/MarketScreener (aggregators)
cio.note: Bio: 'oversees the organization's investment strategy, portfolio performance and capital allocation'; 'over 30 years of investment experience, with more than 20 of these years focused on insurance asset management' (industry start c. mid-1990s, derived, left null). 2025 SCT total covers Oct-Dec only and includes C$3,047,443 sign-on/make-whole awards; paid in USD; separate Global Investments bonus plan (target 140% of salary). Predecessor Raman Srivastava (Global CIO 2017-Dec 2024, now CEO Insight Investment); interim CIOs Harney (Dec 2024-Jun 2025) and CFO Nielsen (Jul-Sep 2025).
